verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents both a CLI with stable JSON output (usable from any script or agent) and an MCP endpoint (streamable HTTP with API key) that lets any MCP client drive projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks programmatically, satisfying the 'documented public API' requirement for AI-native use. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the API's stability and completeness beyond first-party docs, and a full API reference (endpoints/schemas) rather than narrative doc pages.
